subject: 江苏路155号中西女塾东楼与北楼
periodical_publisher: Woman’s Missionary Council of the Methodist Episcopal Church, South
conclusion_zh: 新址1916年已有高年级在购入的住宅开课，1917为后世所记迁校年。1922年9月12日新宿舍正式入住。研究者的现场照片及说明将Lambuth-Clopton Hall与今五一楼连接，市文旅推广网以海涵堂称1922年东楼。北楼景莲堂建于1935年。
limits_zh: 五份同期页可证购置旧宅、分期迁学、新宿舍入住及奉献礼；没有给出东楼的开工日或竣工验收日。海涵堂之名及东楼方位取自中文机构资料，五一堂之名据作者的实地照片。

period_pages.title: Seventh Annual Report, 1916–1917
period_pages.author: Helen Lee Richardson
period_pages.excerpt: The purchase having been approved, an overdraft at five per cent was arranged for at the Hongkong and Shanghai Bank, and on June 27 payment was made in full.
period_pages.reading_zh: 作者记6月27日付清八万两，购得爱丁堡路约九英亩地与既有二十五室住宅，可收容高中部及预科三、四年级共55人。1916由1917年4月开会及文中回叙的上年度推得。

period_pages.title: Seventh Annual Report, 1916–1917
period_pages.author: Woman’s Missionary Council of the Methodist Episcopal Church, South
period_pages.excerpt: a handsome, semiforeign residence, ready for the fall opening
period_pages.reading_zh: 当年秋季原住宅已接收部分学生，访问者另记53名高中学生。此处与第196页所列55人的年级范围有别。

period_pages.title: Eighth Annual Report, 1917–1918
period_pages.author: Woman’s Missionary Council of the Methodist Episcopal Church, South
period_pages.excerpt: the sale of McTyeire and the erection of new buildings be deferred until further authorization by the Council or the Executive Committee
period_pages.reading_zh: 议事录第24、25项分别谈新址土地款与须待进一步授权的新建筑。

period_pages.title: Tenth Annual Report, 1919–1920
period_pages.author: Woman’s Missionary Council of the Methodist Episcopal Church, South
period_pages.excerpt: The immediate pressing necessity is the dormitory. We must build to accommodate three hundred students.
period_pages.reading_zh: 1920年仍拟建可收300人的宿舍，购地时原有的建筑可暂供行政、教学。此合订本印页103对应扫描页序n102。

period_pages.title: Thirteenth Annual Report, 1922–1923
period_pages.author: Martha E. Pyle, Principal
period_pages.excerpt: The absorbing interest of the year was our new dormitory, Lambuth-Clopton Hall. This new building was occupied according to our proposed schedule, September 12. With that date the boarding department of McTyeire School is found at 1 Edinburg Road.
period_pages.reading_zh: 1922年9月12日寄宿部入住新宿舍，当季居住者逾300，汉口路老校小学仍在上课。其后秋季Hay主教举行奉献礼，页中未给具体日期。年份按此卷报告期和文中翌年入学展望判定。

later_sources.title: Ecclesiastical History Society
later_sources.author: Jennifer Bond
later_sources.excerpt: built in 1922, and today known as May First Hall (Wuyi Tang 五一堂)

image.caption: Lambuth-Clopton Hall, built in 1922, was originally the dormitory for McTyiere Girls Middle School. In 1952 McTyiere and St. Mary’s were merged to become the Shanghai Number Three Girls School. Photo by Jennifer Bond, Shanghai, 15 April 2016.
image.role: Author’s dated photograph identifying the present May First Hall; original linked to, privately checked.

later_sources.title: 中西女塾旧址
later_sources.excerpt: 1917年迁至现址,1922年在校园东侧建教学楼海涵堂,1930年改名为中西女中,1935年在北侧建教学楼景莲堂。

later_sources.title: 洋气雅致的彩色玻璃窗，就藏在长宁这所百年名校里
later_sources.excerpt: 五四楼是这所学校历史悠久，保存完好的文物保护建筑，原名景莲堂，建于1935年。
